title: [review] project-LICHEN-iaui.3: Duplicate ctx->state assignments in edhoc.c initiator/responder export_oscore
description:
Code quality issue in lichen/subsys/lichen/edhoc/edhoc.c:
- In edhoc_initiator_export_oscore: line 1040 sets ctx->state = EDHOC_STATE_EXPORTED, then line 1049 sets it again to the same value. The seed wipe was inserted between the duplicate state assignments at line 1042, but the duplicate wasnt cleaned up.
- In edhoc_responder_export_oscore: same pattern at line 1555 and 1564.

Not a correctness bug (harmless overwrite) but confusing dead code. Remove the first assignment on line 1040 and line 1555.
